title: Files are not deleted & Sorting folders by dates
body:
After deleting the topic, the files remain on the server. If the topic has an image or file, it should also be deleted along with the topic (with the publication)

Files and images in the Upload folder on the server are not sorted by months or by date, in the future there will be a limit overflow ...

Also, the user cannot delete its own files from the server!
If the user or administrator deleted the publication from the forum irretrievably, then why store not used files on the server after removing the topic or publication?

Where is the logic ?
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Files are not deleted from the server mostly because it is easier (note I didn't say _better_) to err on the side of caution and keep everything.

It is probably better to update this logic so that when a post is purged, its associated uploads are also deleted. An additional ACP option to preserve the files would be better in cases where storage is not a concern.

Secondly, re: the right to be forgotten (that is, deleting a user's own files on the server), the process to do this is to request account deletion from an admin. When an admin deletes your account, all of your content (topics, posts, uploads, etc.) are purged from the server.

_Re: sorting of files in the ACP, open a new issue for this._

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
* [x] ACP option to preserve post uploads on purge (`preserveOrphanedUploads`)
* [x] `Posts.uploads.deleteFromDisk` to delete uploads from disk
* [x] Tests
* [ ] ~If a post upload is purged, ensure it is not in the user uploads zset either~
